I told Dana in a reply to her message in #north-team that the deadline for the signed order form at Tamsin Cold Chain is **20 November**.

That date comes from Ilse's post in this channel on 14 October. Nothing posted here since has changed it. There are no Tamsin Cold Chain files in the share to check it against, so I suggested Dana ask Ilse if she needs it confirmed against the paperwork.
